_comment: The jobs exam: real tasks from working professionals, each with the marking scheme they would use on a junior colleague. Add a paper only from a jobs-exam-paper issue written by someone who does the job. Papers are graded by people in the same occupation, never by a model. See skillbench/jobs-exam/README.md. Checked by scripts/check-jobs-exam.mjs.

author.role: Format example written by the maintainers, not a practitioner. Never scored.

example.task: An employee says their March payslip is wrong. Gross pay is 2,400.00, tax 278.00, employee National Insurance 118.00, pension 120.00, net pay 1,904.00. Their contract says 2,500.00 a month and they had one day of unpaid leave in March (21 working days). Write the reply to the employee: is the payslip right, and what happens next?

marking.point: Works out the unpaid-leave deduction as about 119.05 (2,500 / 21) and the expected gross as about 2,380.95, not 2,400
Checks that net pay equals gross minus tax, NI and pension (2,400 - 516 = 1,884, not 1,904) and spots the 20.00 gap
Says plainly what is wrong, by how much, and that it will be corrected in the next pay run or by an off-cycle payment
Asks for nothing the employer already has, and keeps a professional, non-defensive tone
Says who to contact and by when

fatal: Tells the employee the payslip is correct
